sentences: rs334 is a missense variant in HBB that changes codon 20 from A to T, resulting in the p.Glu7Val substitution also known as E6V or HbS [F2, F3].

The alternate allele A (T>A) is observed at 0.16% in gnomAD v4 exomes and at 1.3% in gnomAD v4 genomes, with ancestry‑specific frequencies in the exomes ranging from 5.7% in African/African American individuals to 0% in European (Finnish) individuals [F4, F5, F6].
ClinVar classifies this variant as Pathogenic for Hb SS disease and other HBB‑related disorders, while also recording assertions of malaria resistance [F7, F8].
Whole‑genome sequencing analysis reported a single origin of the sickle allele during the Holocene wet phase (Shriner D et al. 2018) [F9].
